name: pda
description: PDA — a multi-workspace journaling app with rich-text blocks, tasks, custom properties, semantic search, AI summaries, and an MCP server. Next.js 14 + Supabase.

overridesNote.jsdom: jsdom arrives transitively via isomorphic-dompurify (lib/sanitize) and is pinned to 26.x, the newest release whose dependency tree contains no CommonJS-file require() of an ESM-only package. Next.js externalises jsdom (it is in next/dist/lib/server-external-packages.json), so it stays a runtime require() in the serverless bundle, and the Next server runtime on Vercel does not implement Node's require(ESM). Any such edge therefore throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM while the module graph loads, before handler code runs, and the route 500s — which is why an unauthenticated GET /api/mcp returned 500 instead of 401. jsdom 27.4+ requires the ESM-only @exodus/bytes, and even 27.3 reaches ESM-only @csstools/*, css-tree 3 and parse5 8. isomorphic-dompurify only ever calls `new JSDOM('<!DOCTYPE html>')`, so 26.x is a drop-in and DOMPurify is untouched. Also declared as a direct dependency so npm hoists it: nested under isomorphic-dompurify it stops matching Next's external list, webpack bundles it, and the build then fails on jsdom's readFileSync of default-stylesheet.css. To verify a bump, run the built server under `node --no-experimental-require-module` — that reproduces the Vercel runtime, which a plain local run does not because Node 22+ allows require(ESM).
